items.title: Dave Brubeck — Smithsonian Jazz Oral History
items.q: The interviewer mentions Pierre Salinger and asks 'whether you know it or not', but the interviewee (Dave Brubeck) does not respond with any personal anecdote, confirmation of meeting, or description of a relationship. The text only shows the interviewer bringing up the name.

ctx.x: How do you approach that? How do you play at the White House? Do you play a song? Do you play a set? How do you adapt to that?

A little background to that: Pierre Salinger, whether you know it or not, could have had a career as a classical pianist. He used to come into the Geary Cellar in San Francisco when he was a writer for the [San Francisco] Chronicle. Didn’t he go with one of the girls downstairs?
